evidence: Both commercially available precursors, TDEAT (Sigma Aldrich) for Ti and Sn(acac) 2 (Sigma Aldrich) for Sn, were kept in stainless steel bubblers and heated up to 65 and 70 /C14 C, respectively, during deposition. The operating and base pressures were maintained at /C24 500 and /C24 20 mTorr, respectively, with ultrahigh purity N as the purging and carrier gas.
